workflows.purpose: Answer a bounded question using authoritative evidence.
Investigate unknowns and reconcile source-backed findings.
Implement approved behavior and verify observable acceptance.
Reproduce a failure, establish its cause, fix and recheck.
Evaluate existing work against explicit acceptance with concrete evidence.
Compare alternatives against constraints before consequential execution.

topologies.solo: One owner handles coupled reasoning, shared invariants or bounded work.
topologies.sequential: Dependent delegated units proceed in verified producer-to-consumer order.
topologies.parallel: Substantial independently checkable branches have exclusive write/output scopes and one integrator.
topologies.generator-evaluator: Generation and selected-input evaluation are separate responsibilities.

templates.select_when: Work is bounded or coupled and delegation would mostly repeat context.
templates.avoid_when: Independent substantial work or consequential acceptance gaps justify another structure.

templates.select_when: Independent discovery questions are the bottleneck before a capable owner builds.
templates.avoid_when: Questions are dependent or the specification is already clear.

templates.select_when: Useful delegated units depend on confirmed upstream artifacts or share mutation boundaries.
templates.avoid_when: One owner can finish the small coupled task without a meaningful handoff.

templates.select_when: Substantial implementation units have agreed interfaces and independent acceptance.
templates.avoid_when: Shared invariants or unresolved interfaces require simultaneous overlapping writers.

templates.select_when: Consequential defects or observed self-review gaps justify separate acceptance checking.
templates.avoid_when: A bounded task has adequate direct verification and another review adds no useful evidence.

templates.select_when: Long-running work needs compact state, artifact dependencies and explicit recovery ownership.
templates.avoid_when: A short task does not need a separate control or continuity layer.

templates.select_when: A correct measured baseline has a diagnosed optimization plateau and approved experiment limits.
templates.avoid_when: The task lacks an executable correctness gate or reliable objective.

inference: The host AI selects task category, template and current-stage topology from evidence; this catalog is not a keyword classifier, scheduler or universal runtime/model ranking.
